arXiv:2607.15079v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 7 月 16 日arXiv:2607.15079v1 [cs.AI] 16 Jul 2026

BrainPilot：通过代理研究自动化大脑发现BrainPilot: Automating Brain Discovery with Agentic Research

Haoxuan Li1,2,*, Tianci Gao2,3,*, Jianhe Li4,*, Yang Fan5,*, Runze Shi1,2, Weiran Wang6, Tianxiang Zhao2,7, Zezhao Wu8, Xiaoyang Jiang9, Qihui Zhang10, Jia Li1, Xiao Xiao6, Kai Du11, Xiaoxuan Jia8, Chao Xie11, Lu Mi1,2,  1College of AI, Tsinghua University 2Shanghai Qizhi Institute 3Business School, Renmin University of China 4School of Physics, Beihang University 5School of Information and Software Engineering, University of Electronic Science and Technology of China 6Behavioral and Cognitive Neuroscience Center, Institute of Science and Technology for Brain-Inspired Intelligence, Fudan University 7College of Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology 8School of Life Sciences & IDG/McGovern Institute for Brain Research, Tsinghua University 9School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, Southwest Jiaotong University 10Weixian College, Tsinghua University 11Department of Psychological and Cognitive Sciences, Tsinghua University
摘要Abstract

了解大脑越来越依赖于整合证据 规模、方式和学科。解决单一研究问题 因此需要协调一致的操作顺序，从先前的测量开始 致力于根据领域执行分析和解释结果 知识。人工智能 代理商承诺加速这一过程，但目前的代理商缺乏领域 脑科学方面的专业知识，可能会捏造主张，在多步骤过程中发生漂移 推理，并为专家干预提供一些明确的要点。这些失败 在脑科学领域尤其昂贵，因为脑科学的结论会反馈到下游 科学主张并依赖于实验室特定的专业知识和细心的人类 判断。我们呈现Understanding the brain increasingly depends on integrating evidence across scales, modalities, and disciplines. Addressing a single research question therefore requires a coordinated sequence of operations, from surveying prior work to executing analyses and interpreting results in light of domain knowledge. AI agents promise to accelerate this process, but current agents lack domain expertise in brain science, may fabricate claims, drift during multi-step reasoning, and offer few defined points for expert intervention. These failures are especially costly in brain science, where conclusions feed into downstream scientific claims and depend on laboratory-specific expertise and careful human judgment. We present大脑飞行员BrainPilot111https://github.com/NeuroAIHub/BrainPilot, 一个, a完全开源fully open-source加速脑科学研究的多智能体系统 具有可追溯的日志和经过代理验证的结果。首席研究员 (PI) 代理协调基于特定领域知识的专业代理： 一个统一的脑科学知识库，包含 7,233 个索引项目和 涵盖七个研究领域的 72 个可重复使用的方法单元的技能库。 每个主要步骤都记录在跟踪图中， 链接子目标、工具使用、证据和声明的可审计记录 允许研究人员跟踪和检查工作流程。审计代理人进一步 将制造检查集成到工作流程中。为了进行评估，我们运行了三个 特工最后考试中的脑科学任务，介绍我们自己的基准，multi-agent system that accelerates brain science research with traceable logs and agent-verified results. A principal investigator (PI) agent coordinates specialist agents grounded in curated domain knowledge: a unified brain science knowledge base containing 7,233 indexed items and a skill library of 72 reusable methodology units across seven research domains. Every major step is recorded in the Graph of Trace, an auditable record that links subgoals, tool use, evidence, and claims and allows researchers to follow and inspect the workflow. An Auditor agent further integrates fabrication checking into the workflow. For evaluation, we run three brain science tasks from Agents’ Last Exam, introduce our own benchmark,BrainPilotBench-v0222https://github.com/NeuroAIHub/BrainPilotBench, 并提出额外的端到端案例研究。在这些评价中， 具有开源骨干模型的 BrainPilot 可以以更低的成本实现与最先进的代理框架相当的性能。, and present additional end-to-end case studies. Across these evaluations, BrainPilot with an open-source backbone model attains performance comparable to state-of-the-art agent framework with less costs.

1 简介Introduction

在一个世纪的神经科学研究中，科学家们一直在追求理解的持久使命 智力的本质。人工智能 (AI) 的快速发展已经 人们重新关注什么是智力以及它是如何产生的。然而脑科学的进步越来越依赖于整合证据 跨尺度、模式和学科For a century of neuroscience studies, scientists have pursued an enduring mission of understanding the nature of intelligence. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have renewed attention to what intelligence is and how it arises. Yet progress in brain science increasingly depends on integrating evidence across scales, modalities, and disciplines(Akil et al., 2011; Zeng and Sanes, 2017; Paninski and Cunningham, 2018)。现代大脑 因此，研究是一个数据和协调密集型的事业， 利用快速扩展的文献、异构数据集、专门的 分析工具和社区规模的举措. Modern brain research is consequently a data- and coordination-intensive enterprise, drawing on rapidly expanding literatures, heterogeneous datasets, specialized analytical tools, and community-scale initiatives(Poldrack and Gorgolewski, 2014; Grillner et al., 2016)。 脑科学研究需要跨多种方式协调文献检索、实验设计、数据分析和科学解释. Brain science research requires coordinating literature retrieval, experimental design, data analysis, and scientific interpretation across multiple modalities(BRAIN Initiative Cell Census Network (BICCN), 2021)。这些操作非常耗时，难以重现，并且 对分析选择敏感. These operations are time-consuming, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to analytical choices(Frégnac, 2017; Urai et al., 2022).

脑科学缺乏进展。The lack of advances in brain science.

人工智能代理的出现带来了及时的技术能力来满足科学需求，脑科学越来越需要能够组织的系统 并加速复杂的研究工作流程，同时保留专家判断 该字段取决于哪个。科学代理人正在成为实用工具 加速跨多个领域的发现。在化学中，自主主体 已用于通过结合语言来设计、计划和执行实验 具有网络搜索、文档检索、代码执行和实验室的模型 自动化The emergence of AI agents brings timely technical capability to meet scientific need, where brain science increasingly requires systems that can organize and accelerate complex research workflows while preserving the expert judgment on which the field depends. Scientific agents are becoming practical tools for accelerating discovery across multiple domains. In chemistry, autonomous agents have been used to design, plan, and perform experiments by combining language models with web search, documentation retrieval, code execution, and laboratory automation(Boiko et al., 2023; Bran et al., 2024)。在更广泛的计算中 科学的、以工具为导向的代理已经被开发出来来选择和执行 跨领域的专业科学工具. In broader computational science, tool-oriented agents have been developed to select and execute specialized scientific tools across domains(Huang et al., 2025)。在脑科学中，语言模型 根据文献进行训练或评估已显示出预测的希望 实验结果表明大规模模型可以帮助综合 知识密集型领域的先前发现. In brain science, language models trained or evaluated on the literature have shown promise in predicting experimental outcomes, suggesting that large-scale models can help synthesize prior findings in knowledge-intensive fields(Luo et al., 2025)，但是 这仅涉及更广泛的多步骤研究过程中脑科学的一部分。, but this addresses only one part of brain science within the broader multi-step research process.

科学有效性的重要性。The importance of scientific validity.

上述工作确立了智能体辅助科学的可行性，但从另一个重要角度来看，进展仍然不成熟： 代理人可以捏造主张，跨越多步骤推理，并为专家干预提供一些明确定义的要点The above works establish the feasibility of agent-assisted science, yet advances remains immature from another important perspective: agents can fabricate claims, drift across multi-step reasoning, and offer few clearly defined points for expert intervention(Liu et al., 2023; Lin et al., 2025)。这些弱点被放大 在脑科学领域，实验室特定的专业知识、仔细的控制和 迭代专家的判断至关重要。 为了使人工智能辅助加速在脑科学中发挥作用，该研究 流程必须保持可信，并且人类的专业知识必须保持在循环中 它可以影响决策的点。大规模证据表明人类与人工智能 组合 只有当合作经过精心设计时，才能超越单独的一方. These weaknesses are amplified in brain science, where laboratory-specific expertise, careful controls, and iterative experts’ judgment are essential. For AI-assisted acceleration to be useful in brain science, the research process must remain trustworthy, and human expertise must remain in the loop at points where it can shape decisions. Large-scale evidence shows that human–AI combinations outperform either alone only when the collaboration is carefully designed(Vaccaro et al., 2024)。这一发现激发了界面的产生 专家可以在评估最终答案的同时检查和指导过程. This finding motivates interfaces through which experts can inspect and guide the process while evaluating the final answer(Shao et al., 2025)。科学结论取决于 导致这些结果的证据、假设、操作和判断，以及 关于最终的答案。 一个搜索文献、选择分析、 调用工具并生成解释，因此应该揭示如何 中间结果的产生以及它们如何支持后来的主张。 这一要求在脑科学中尤其重要，因为脑科学中存在异质性 证据往往允许多种解释，需要专家判断 评估方法选择、实验控制和合理性 结论. Scientific conclusions depend on the evidence, assumptions, operations, and judgments that lead to them, as well as on the final answer. A system that searches the literature, selects analyses, invokes tools, and generates interpretations should therefore reveal how intermediate results are produced and how they support later claims. This requirement is especially important in brain science, where heterogeneous evidence often admits multiple interpretations and expert judgment is needed to evaluate methodological choices, experimental controls, and the plausibility of conclusions(Vaccaro et al., 2024)。 很多相关的 专业知识也是实验室特定的且记录很少：程序、 默认值和经验法则因实验室而异，并且很少进入 训练大型语言模型的文献，使得通用模型很难替代该领域。. Much of the relevant expertise is also laboratory-specific and poorly documented: procedures, defaults, and rules of thumb vary across laboratories and rarely enter the literature on which large language models are trained, making a general-purpose model poor stand-in for the field.

这些需求使得用于脑科学研究的人工智能系统不仅仅是应用于新领域的通用系统，并直接塑造其设计：策划的知识和可重用的技能提供领域基础，PI主导的专家协调在多步骤工作流程中保持一致性，专用模块公开证据和主张以供专家审查，同时协调跨规模和模式的证据，在长工作流程中保留方法论约束，并支持其有效性取决于领域专业知识和实验背景的决策。These demands make an AI system for brain science research more than a general-purpose system applied to a new domain and directly shape its design: curated knowledge and reusable skills provide domain grounding, PI-led specialist coordination maintains coherence across multi-step workflows, and dedicated modules expose evidence and claims for expert review while reconciling evidence across scales and modalities, preserving methodological constraints across long workflows, and supporting decisions whose validity depends on domain expertise and experimental context.

在这里我们介绍Here we present大脑飞行员BrainPilot，一个人机循环多智能体系统 通过协调领域知识加速脑科学研究， 分析技能，以及可追踪工作流程中的专业代理，其中 中间行动、证据和索赔仍然可供专家使用 检查和评估。 (1) BrainPilot通过一个机制来组织研究任务 首席研究员 (PI) 代理人和文献检索专家代理人， 实验和分析规划、执行、解释和审核。 (2) 代理基于本地组装的精选领域知识，而不是 而不是依赖底层语言模型恰好记住的内容： 统一的脑科学知识库包含 7,233 个索引项目和 涵盖七个研究领域的 72 个可重复使用的方法单元的技能库。 (3) 他们的行为被记录为结构化的 链接子目标、工具使用、证据和生成的声明的工作流程跟踪。 这种设计允许研究人员跟踪任务，检查其基础 中间输出，并在整个过程中应用领域判断。 (4) 我们根据 Agents’ Last Exam 中的三项脑科学相关研究对 BrainPilot 进行评估, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system for accelerating brain science research by coordinating domain knowledge, analytical skills, and specialist agents within a traceable workflow in which intermediate actions, evidence, and claims remain available for expert inspection and evaluation. (1) BrainPilot organizes research tasks through a principal investigator (PI) agent and specialist agents for literature search, experimental and analytical planning, execution, interpretation, and audit. (2) The agents are grounded in curated domain knowledge assembled locally rather than relying on what the underlying language model happens to remember: a unified brain science knowledge base containing 7,233 indexed items and a skill library of 72 reusable methodology units across seven research domains. (3) Their actions are recorded as a structured workflow trace that links subgoals, tool use, evidence, and generated claims. This design allows researchers to follow a task, examine the basis of intermediate outputs, and apply domain judgment throughout the process. (4) We evaluate BrainPilot on the three brain science related studies from Agents’ Last Exam(Sun et al., 2026)，以及我们新提出的基准, as well as our newly proposed benchmarkBrainPilotBench-v0，初步版本包括评估脑科学研究中的代理的四项科学任务（第, with a preliminary version including four scientific tasks that evaluate agents in brain science studies (Section4.2），我们还进行了五个案例研究来评估 BrainPilot 在现实世界脑科学研究工作流程中的应用。), we also conducted five case studies to evaluate BrainPilot in the real-world brain science research workflows.

2 相关工作Related Work

2.1 科学人工智能AI for science

大型语言模型已应用于各个科学领域 研究过程的部分自动化Large language model have been applied across scientific domains to automate parts of the research process(Xi et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2024; Wei et al., 2025b; Zhang et al., 2025)。 在化学领域，自主代理将语言模型与精心设计的工具结合起来， 文档检索、代码执行和机器人平台来规划和 进行实验. In chemistry, autonomous agents combine language models with curated tools, documentation retrieval, code execution, and robotic platforms to plan and carry out experiments(Boiko et al., 2023; Bran et al., 2024)和自主实验室 将此类规划与机器人合成相结合，以端到端地运行实验, and autonomous laboratories couple such planning with robotic synthesis to run experiments end to end(Szymanski et al., 2023)。在生物医学中，通用代理与 用于执行任务的大量精选工具、软件和数据库集合 例如基因优先排序和药物再利用. In biomedicine, general-purpose agents work with large curated collections of tools, software, and databases to perform tasks such as gene prioritization and drug repurposing(Huang et al., 2025)，同时 多智能体系统生成假设、设计实验并分析 整个发现周期的结果, while multi-agent systems generate hypotheses, design experiments, and analyze results across the discovery cycle(Ghareeb et al., 2026; Gottweis et al., 2026)。更广泛地说，代理系统 已经转向研究过程本身的自动化，从 想法到手稿. More broadly, agentic systems have moved toward automating the research process itself, from idea to manuscript(Lu et al., 2024; 2026)。基础模型 对于生物分子，包括预测蛋白质结构的模型 接近实验的准确性，表明学习模型可以解决长期存在的问题 科学问题. Foundation models for biomolecules, including models that predict protein structures at near-experimental accuracy, show that learned models can solve long-standing scientific problems(Jumper et al., 2021)。这些系统表明 代理和模型可以执行科学工作流程的重要部分。他们 主要设计用于最大限度地提高任务绩效和自主性，记录 他们的中间步骤作为日志。. These systems demonstrate that agents and models can perform substantial parts of scientific workflows. They are designed primarily to maximize task performance and autonomy, recording their intermediate steps as logs.

2.2 脑科学人工智能代理AI agent for brain science

越来越多的系统将代理人工智能引入脑科学。有些自动化 从姿势到端对端的神经行为学和动物行为分析 通过统计分析进行估计以生成报告A growing number of systems bring agentic AI to brain science. Some automate neuroethology and animal-behavior analysis end to end, from pose estimation through statistical profiling to report generation(Chen et al., 2026)。其他人直接对原始多模式神经影像进行操作 数据并编排可重复的分析管道. Others operate directly on raw multimodal neuroimaging data and orchestrate reproducible analysis pipelines(Wang et al., 2026a)。还构建了多代理框架 自主脑信号理解、分解脑机接口 工作流程进入中央主管下的专门子代理. Multi-agent frameworks have also been built for autonomous brain-signal understanding, decomposing brain–computer-interface workflows into specialized sub-agents under a central supervisor(Zhou et al., 2026)，并且代理驱动系统已应用于 心灵科学，推测和测试人类的计算模型 行为, and agent-driven systems have been applied to the science of mind, conjecturing and testing computational models of human behavior(Prystawski et al., 2026)。这些系统表明，专门 代理可以通过有限的手动操作通过多个步骤进行脑科学分析 努力。他们专注于特定的分析流程，而多步骤 达到结果的过程很大程度上仍然是系统内部的。 这很重要，因为代理系统仍然容易产生幻觉、指令 漂移和无声错误，这是值得信赖和可靠的文献 代理被认为是可靠部署的主要障碍. These systems show that specialized agents can carry brain science analyses through many steps with limited manual effort. They focus on particular analysis pipelines, while the multi-step process by which a result is reached remains largely internal to the system. This matters because agentic systems remain prone to hallucination, instruction drift, and silent error, which the literature on trustworthy and reliable agents identifies as central obstacles to dependable deployment(Liu et al., 2023; Yu et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2025).

2.3 科学代理人的基准Benchmarks for scientific agents

评估此类系统催生了多种类型的基准测试。知识 基准测试了许多人的事实和推理能力 科目，包括生物学和医学Evaluating such systems has motivated several types of benchmarks. Knowledge benchmarks test factual and reasoning ability across many subjects, including biology and medicine(Hendrycks et al., 2021)。任务 基准评估代理的数据驱动科学编码和发现， 通过执行生成的程序对每个任务进行评分. Task benchmarks evaluate agents on data-driven scientific coding and discovery, scoring each task by executing the generated programs(Chen et al., 2025; Majumder et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025)。 最近的评估从孤立的任务扩展到更长的研究工作流程。一个 最近的评论区分了发现、执行和验证、综合、 和以来源为导向的工具. Recent evaluations extend from isolated tasks to longer research workflows. A recent review distinguishes discovery, execution and verification, synthesis, and provenance-oriented instruments(Tie et al., 2026)。 AIRS-长凳 涵盖创意生成、实验分析和迭代细化 20 项机器学习研究任务，而 FIRE-Bench 评估智能体是否 可以通过自主实验重新发现已发表的科学见解. AIRS-Bench covers idea generation, experimental analysis, and iterative refinement across 20 machine-learning research tasks, while FIRE-Bench evaluates whether agents can rediscover published scientific insights through autonomous experimentation(Lupidi et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026c)。 ResearchClawBench 评估 对 10 个科学领域的 40 项基于论文的任务进行端到端研究 使用专家策划的多模式评价标准. ResearchClawBench evaluates end-to-end research on 40 paper-grounded tasks across 10 scientific domains using expert-curated multimodal rubrics(Xu et al., 2026), 和 NatureBench 将 Nature 系列论文中的 90 个任务打包到容器中 具有隐藏测试集和自动评估器的环境, and NatureBench packages 90 tasks from Nature-family papers into containerized environments with hidden test sets and automated evaluators(Wang et al., 2026b)。 对于脑科学，BrainBench 评估模型是否可以预测 文献中神经科学实验的结果. For brain science, BrainBench evaluates whether models can predict the outcomes of neuroscience experiments from the literature(Luo et al., 2025)。这些资源共同推动评估 以论文为基础的多步骤研究，但仍然是一般性的机器学习 中心的，或者跨域的。. Together, these resources move evaluation toward paper-grounded, multi-step research, but remain general, machine-learning centric, or cross-domain.

3 系统System

BrainPilot 是一个系统 通过协调领域知识加速脑科学研究， 在 PI Agent 上实施的可追踪工作流程中的分析技能和专业代理BrainPilot is a system for accelerating brain science research by coordinating domain knowledge, analytical skills, and specialist agents within a traceable workflow implemented on PI Agent333https://github.com/earendil-works/pi。 它结合了三个 担任经过代理人验证的研究助理的要素：专业代理人 开展研究（第. It combines three elements to serve as a agent-verified research assistant: specialist agents that carry out the research (Section3.1），策划的领域知识 为这些药物奠定了脑科学的基础（第), curated domain knowledge that grounds those agents in brain science (Section3.2），和一个 以可审计的形式记录整个过程的跟踪图 （节), and a Graph of Trace that records the entire process in an auditable form (Section3.3）。 图). Figure2显示这些部件如何集成到一个系统中。shows how these parts are integrated into one system.

3.1 多代理系统和代理角色Multi-agent system and agent roles

BrainPilot 与由以下人员领导的专家团队一起执行研究任务 PI 代理。用户向 PI 陈述一个目标，PI 将其分解、委托 将子任务分配给适合每个部分的专家代理，并整合他们的 结果进入最终输出。用户可以查看和检查每个人的工作情况 代理。默认团队有 6 名代理（表BrainPilot carries out a research task with a team of specialist agents led by the PI agent. The user states a goal to the PI, which decomposes it, delegates subtasks to the specialist agents suited to each part, and integrates their results into the final output. The user can view and inspect the work of every agent. The default team has six agents (Table1）。五、落实 研究，而审计员使工作流程值得信赖。每个代理都是 定义由三部分组成： 共享系统 宪法 建立通用规则 致所有代理商；角色定义指定代理的使命、工作风格、 以及可用的工具；一组技能提供了其模块化功能。 所有代理共享任务和回复的消息传递合同，自我记录 将其有形输出记录到跟踪图的合约。). Five carry out the research, while the Auditor makes the workflow trustworthy. Each agent is defined with three parts: a shared system constitution establishes rules common to all agents; a role definition specifies the agent’s mission, working style, and available tools; and a set of skills supplies its modular capabilities. All agents share a messaging contract for tasks and replies, a self-recording contract that logs their tangible outputs to the Graph of Trace.

每个专家代理将特定于角色的认知风格与一小组 的动手工具。图书馆员强调归纳综合和批判 评估，仅通过搜索和阅读工具进行。的 实验主义者运用操作、控制和测量思维 制作设计文件，委托实质性的 实施给工程师。工程师优先考虑精度和 重现性，并使用文件和 shell 工具来编写、运行和报告代码 会话工作区。作者注重清晰度、准确性和受众 在该工作空间中组装最终文档时的意识。 PI代表 需要领域专业知识或超过几分钟的工作，同时处理 直接进行轻量级框架、合成和决策。它还可以执行 小型检查并为简单的请求生成简短的工件。Each specialist agent combines a role-specific cognitive style with a small set of hands-on tools. The Librarian emphasizes inductive synthesis and critical evaluation, working exclusively through search and read tools. The Experimentalist applies operational, control, and measurement thinking to produce design documents, delegating substantial implementation to the Engineer. The Engineer prioritizes precision and reproducibility and uses file and shell tools to write, run, and report code in the session workspace. The Writer focuses on clarity, precision, and audience awareness when assembling final documents in that workspace. The PI delegates work that requires domain expertise or more than a few minutes, while handling lightweight framing, synthesis, and decisions directly. It can also perform small inspections and produce short artifacts for simple requests.

代理通过称为模块化能力单元获得特定于任务的能力 技能。对它们的访问是通过技能路由器工具进行的。代理查询 带有当前任务关键字的路由器并读取返回的技能 需求。 PI、图书馆员、 实验者、工程师和作家都共享这个工具并遵循相同的方法Agents acquire task-specific abilities through modular capability units called skills. Access to them is mediated by a skill-router tool. An agent queries the router with keywords for its current task and reads the returned skills on demand. The PI, Librarian, Experimentalist, Engineer, and Writer all share this tool and follow the same技能第一skills-first预检：在采用一种重要的方法之前， 代理查询匹配的技能，如果存在，则遵循其 指导作为方法论基础。这保留了每个代理的工作上下文 简短并在实践中锚定其选择。preflight: before committing to a nontrivial methodology, the agent queries for a matching skill and, when one exists, follows its guidance as the methodological basis. This keeps each agent’s working context short and anchors its choices in practice.

的The审计员Auditor智能体的角色被故意缩小，以检查其他智能体的输出是否包含影响科学结果的错误。语言模型代理可以产生不受支持的流畅声明 会议中的任何内容，并且在科学背景下，此类主张构成 实质性的失败。为了防止这种情况，PI 路由专家代理 交付前通过适当的审查阶段输出。它首先路由 通过 Writer 需要类似报告结构的可交付成果，然后发送 将最终的草案提交给审计员进行独立核查。审计员对草案中的主张提出问题：是否有证据支持 会话自己的工作区？它对数字声明、文件或工件进行分类 经确认、未经证实或有争议的参考文献和外部引用 检查其他代理生成的文件。当证据是 如果不明确，它可能会向始发代理询问特定的指针。每次审核 在会话工作区中保存为带时间戳的报告，以及一条短消息 通知 PI 它的位置。这将验证集成到长期工作流程中，并减轻了用户的负担。agent has a deliberately narrow role to check if the output of other agents contain errors which influence the scientifc results. Language-model agents can produce fluent claims unsupported by anything in the session, and in a scientific setting such a claim constitutes a substantive failure. To guard against this, the PI routes specialist-agent output through the appropriate review stages before delivery. It first routes deliverables that need report-like structure through the Writer, then sends the resulting draft to the Auditor for independent verification. The Auditor asks questions claim in the draft: is it backed by evidence in the session’s own workspace? It classifies numerical claims, file or artifact references, and external citations as confirmed, unverified, or disputed by checking files produced by the other agents. When evidence is ambiguous, it may ask the originating agent for a specific pointer. Each audit is saved as a timestamped report in the session workspace, and a short message notifies the PI of its location. This integrates verification into long-horizon workflow and relieves the user of that burden.

3.2 领域知识Domain knowledge

BrainPilot 通过两项知识资产将其代理扎根于脑科学领域 离线构建：检索知识库和 技能库。两者都作为服务向代理公开，使他们能够 将策划的领域知识与其参数知识相结合。BrainPilot grounds its agents in brain science through two knowledge assets built offline: a retrieval knowledge base and a skill library. Both are exposed to the agents as services, allowing them to combine curated domain knowledge with their parametric knowledge.

知识库。Knowledge base.

检索知识库是由以下内容构建的单个统一向量索引： 开源神经科学教科书和研究文献，总共 7,233 篇索引书籍和论文。The retrieval knowledge base is a single unified vector index built from open-source neuroscience textbooks and the research literature, 7,233 indexed books and papers in total.444所有编入索引的资源均已获得权利所有者的各自许可。All resources indexed were obtained with the respective permission of rights holders.该语料库涵盖 11 个学科组。精神病学所占比例最大（2,172 项；30.0%），其次是心理学和认知（1,249 项；17.3%）、系统和成像神经科学（1,006 项；13.9%）以及人工智能、机器学习和计算机科学（929 项；12.8%）。论文标题和摘要总共包含 377,868 个内容标记。图The corpus spans 11 disciplinary groups. Psychiatry accounts for the largest share (2,172 items; 30.0%), followed by psychology and cognition (1,249; 17.3%), systems and imaging neuroscience (1,006; 13.9%), and AI, machine learning, and computer science (929; 12.8%). Paper titles and abstracts collectively contain 377,868 content tokens. Figure4排除常见的科学散文填充词后，呈现 400 个最常用的术语。presents the 400 most frequent terms after excluding common scientific-prose filler.

知识库的构建分三个阶段进行（图The construction of the knowledge base proceeds in three stages (Figure3）。源文档首先转换为文本 DeepSeek-OCR). Source documents are first converted to text with DeepSeek-OCR(Wei et al., 2025a).555https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR然后，文本被分成重叠的段落（1,500 个字符的块，其中包含 200 个字符的重叠），并且每个段落都嵌入到 使用密集检索编码器 BAAI 的 1,024 维向量 bge-m3The text is then split into overlapping passages (1,500-character chunks with a 200-character overlap), and each passage is embedded into a 1,024-dimensional vector with the dense retrieval encoder BAAI bge-m3(Chen et al., 2024).666https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-m3在查询时，代理的问题被嵌入并与索引进行匹配 两阶段检索过程。首先选择候选段落 向量相似度，然后使用交叉编码器按相关性重新排序 来自同一模型系列 BAAI 的重新排序器 bge-reranker-v2-m3。At query time, an agent’s question is embedded and matched against the index in a two-stage retrieval procedure. Candidate passages are first selected by vector similarity and then reordered by relevance using a cross-encoder reranker from the same model family, BAAI bge-reranker-v2-m3.777https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3这使图书馆员和团队其他成员能够了解教科书背景 并发表调查结果作为证据。同一管道可以处理新添加的文献 并允许语料库不断增长以供任何代理应用程序使用。This gives the Librarian and the rest of the team access to textbook background and published findings as evidence. The same pipeline can process newly added literature and allow the corpus to grow for use with any agent applications.

技能库和路由。Skill library and routing.

技能是一种独立的、 可重用的能力单元，可以是描述性的或可执行的。描述性的 技能记录了一种方法以及何时应用它，而可执行技能则携带 代码，例如从已建立的工具派生的预处理例程。技能库包含可供代理使用的专业功能。目前持有72 技能分为 7 个更广泛的研究 领域：细胞、分子、遗传学和药理学；认知和 行为研究；地基和基础设施；人类神经影像学和 电生理学；计算模型和理论；文献和报告 工具；以及临床和应用研究。 我们还为越来越多接触代理上下文的技能设计了一个技能路由器。 路由器在代理和技能之间提供两级接口 图书馆。代理 首先使用与任务相关的关键字搜索库并收到一个紧凑的 一组候选人技能，然后加载所选候选人的完整说明 仅当需要该能力时才使用该技能。 PI、图书馆员、实验员、 工程师和作家共享此界面并将其作为技能优先应用 在采用重要方法之前进行预检。将技能发现与 技能加载限制了搜索和完成技能时的上下文开销 在执行期间加载显式且可测量的。A skill is a self-contained, reusable capability unit that may be descriptive or executable. Descriptive skills record a method and when to apply it, while executable skills carry code, such as a preprocessing routine derived from an established tool. The skill library contains specialized capabilities made available to agents. It currently holds 72 skills grouped into 7 broader research domains: cellular, molecular, genetics, and pharmacology; cognitive and behavioral research; foundation and infrastructure; human neuroimaging and electrophysiology; computational modeling and theory; literature and reporting tools; and clinical and applied research. We also design a skill router for a growingly number of skills exposed to agent’s contexts. The router provides a two-stage interface between agents and the skill library. An agent first searches the library using task-relevant keywords and receives a compact set of candidate skills and then loads the complete instructions for a selected skill only when that capability is needed. The PI, Librarian, Experimentalist, Engineer, and Writer share this interface and apply it as a skills-first preflight before adopting a nontrivial method. Separating skill discovery from skill loading limits context overhead while making searches and complete skill loads explicit and measurable during execution.

技能取自三 补充来源： LLM 驱动的创作管道，可从 规范，一种从纸质文件中提取方法论的管道 来自脑科学出版物的处方和工具衍生的管道 将现有的分析软件变成实用指南。图书馆 目前整合了广泛使用的神经科学分析中衍生的技能 工具，包括用于动物姿势估计的 DeepLabCutSkills are drawn from three complementary sources: an LLM-driven authoring pipeline that produces general-purpose skills from a specification, a paper-derived pipeline that distills methodological prescriptions from brain science publications, and a tool-derived pipeline that turns established analysis software into practical guides. The library currently integrates skills derived from widely used neuroscience analysis tools, including DeepLabCut for animal pose estimation(Mathis et al., 2018), MNE-Python 用于处理人类神经生理学数据, MNE-Python for processing human neurophysiological data888https://github.com/mne-tools/mne-python, fMRIPrep 用于预处理 fMRI 数据, fMRIPrep for preprocessing fMRI Data999https://github.com/nipreps/fmriprep, 用于网络神经科学的 netneurotools, netneurotools for network neuroscience(Liu et al., 2025), pycortex 用于可视化皮质表面的体积神经成像数据, pycortex for visualizing volumetric neuroimaging data on cortical surfaces(Gao et al., 2015)，以及用于尖峰排序的 SpikeInterface, and SpikeInterface for spike sorting(Buccino et al., 2020)。 图书馆 还包括扩展新来源构建过程的元技能：. The library also includes meta-skills that extend the construction process for new sources:纸到技能paper-to-skill和and存储库到技能repo-to-skill从中提取方法 出版物和软件，同时distill methods from publications and software, while工作流程技能创建者workflow-skill-creator包 已完成手续。这些元技能提供了一个通用的、可扩展的工作流程 将新的方法论知识转化为可重用的能力单元，同时 保留明确的验证步骤。packages completed procedures. These meta-skills provide a common, extensible workflow for turning new methodological knowledge into reusable capability units while retaining an explicit verification step.

3.3 轨迹图Graph of Trace

第三个元素是跟踪图 (GoT)，使工作流程可检查。它 被实施为代理可用的工具 （图The third element, the Graph of Trace (GoT), makes the workflow inspectable. It is implemented as a tool available to the agents (Figure2）。完成子任务后，每个主要代理都会调用 GoT 工具并报告其生成的内容。该工具根据这些构建图表 报告，将出处与任何单个代理的运行方式分开。它 将每个报告转换为包含模式验证的节点 描述、对所产生的工件的引用及其标识符 家长步骤。然后，它推断出编码因果或逻辑的依赖边 超越时间顺序的进展。节点被附加到 仅附加记录，禁止追溯编辑、循环和孤立 引用，因此图单调增长为显式有向无环 工作流程图。前端实时渲染该图并让 用户在执行继续时检查任何节点的元数据，从而允许 在出现错误之前应遵循、审查和纠正的研究轨迹 传播。跟踪图的设计和评估在). After completing a subtask, each major agent calls the GoT tool and reports what it produced. The tool builds the graph from these reports, keeping provenance separate from how any individual agent runs. It converts each report into a schema-validated node containing a description, references to the artifacts produced, and the identifiers of its parent steps. It then infers dependency edges that encode causal or logical progression beyond temporal order. Nodes are appended to an append-only record that forbids retrospective edits, cycles, and orphaned references, so the graph grows monotonically into an explicit directed acyclic graph of the workflow. A frontend renders this graph in real time and lets the user inspect any node’s metadata while execution continues, allowing the research trajectory to be followed, reviewed, and corrected before an error propagates. The design and evaluation of the Graph of Trace is demonstrated in(Gao et al., 2026).

评价详情。Evaluation details.

三个细节定义了这些范围 结果。首先，ALE 的任务是围绕桌面 GUI 软件（3D Slicer、 FSLeyes 和跟踪应用程序）。 BrainPilot 使用代码代替 图形界面，以编程方式解决每个任务，并产生相同的结果 所需的输出文件。这种方法是基准允许的，其 评分仅取决于交付的内容 文物。Three details define the scope of these results. First, ALE’s tasks are written around desktop GUI software (3D Slicer, FSLeyes, and a tracking application). BrainPilot used code in place of a graphical interface, solved each task programmatically, and produced the same required output files. 尽管 Agents’ Last Exam 是一个通用基准，但我们也 介绍Whereas Agents’ Last Exam is a general-purpose benchmark, we also introduceBrainPilotBench-v0，建立了一个基准 专门针对脑科学代理人。与 ALE 一样，每个任务都定义输入， 所需的可交付成果，以及执行前特定任务的评分者；分级机 根据冻结参考或保留标签评估提交的工件 代理运行后, a benchmark built specifically for brain science agents. Like ALE, each task defines the input, required deliverables, and a task-specific grader before execution; the grader evaluates the submitted artifacts against a frozen reference or held-out labels after the agent run(Sun et al., 2026)。初始套件包含四个任务 涵盖钙成像、功能连接功能磁共振成像、运动想象脑电图和 睡眠脑电图。. The initial suite contains four tasks spanning calcium imaging, functional-connectivity fMRI, motor-imagery EEG, and sleep EEG.

RSC 定位细胞分析RSC place-cell analysis提供多会话 双光子钙活性和小鼠在跑步机上跑步的虚拟现实行为 90厘米轨道provides multi-session two-photon calcium activity and virtual-reality behavior from mice running on a 90-cm track(Mao et al., 2020)。该代理执行位置细胞筛选， 群体可视化、位置解码、试验箱相关性和 发射率分析，并提交 机器可读的摘要、科学报告和图表。分级员检查 位置单元比率、解码重要性以及相对于洗牌的改进 解码；可视化、试验箱和发射率输出保留为 诊断。. The agent performs place-cell screening, population visualization, position decoding, trial-bin correlation, and firing-rate analyses, and submits a machine-readable summary, a scientific report, and figures. 功能磁共振成像TOPS-fMRI提供来自 279 个区域的实验强直性疼痛队列的动态功能连接和疼痛评级，产生 38,781 个边缘provides dynamic functional connectivity and pain ratings from an experimental tonic-pain cohort across 279 regions, yielding 38,781 edges(Lee et al., 2021)。代理首先训练线性强直性疼痛特征，并提交其权重向量和截距、清单、仅限 NumPy 的推理程序、边序验证、模型卡和报告。然后，分级人员根据保留的临床背痛严重程度数据评估提交的计划，然后根据来自日本和英国的两个独立的慢性背痛病例对照队列进行评估。最终评分结合了临床疼痛严重程度的特定条件皮尔逊相关性和两个队列中患者对照歧视的 AUC 值。. The agent first trains a linear tonic-pain signature and submits its weight vector and intercept, manifest, NumPy-only inference program, edge-order validation, model card, and report. The grader then evaluates the submitted program on held-out clinical back-pain severity data, followed by two independent chronic-back-pain case–control cohorts from Japan and the UK. The final score combines condition-specific Pearson correlations for clinical pain severity with AUC values for patient–control discrimination in the two cohorts.

基于工件的评分。Artifact-based scoring.

每个评分者对代理运行期间生成的提交工件进行评分，而不是对 自我报告的结果。任务分数标准化为Each grader scores the submitted artifact produced during the agent run, not a self-reported result. Task scores are normalized to[0,1][0,1];有效分数为 零报告为; a valid score of zero is reported as0.000.00。 “F”表示没有有效主要的运行 可以计算分数，因为所需的工件丢失或格式错误， 提交超时，或者评分失败。不转换为数值 零。附录. “F” denotes a run for which no valid primary score can be computed because required artifacts are missing or malformed, the submission times out, or the scorer fails. It is not converted to numerical zero. AppendixB.1给出确切的任务特定 定义。gives the exact task-specific definitions.

隔离和完整性。Isolation and integrity.

任务版本、提示、工件 合同、预处理、数据分割、评分公式和内容哈希 执行前已修复。代理运行仅接收其准备好的工作区，并且 公共任务输入。评分 将评估者的输入阶段置于代理工作区之外。提交的代码执行于 具有只读代码、模型和功能挂载的无网络、非根容器； 只有它的预测目录是可写的。值得信赖的 任务拥有的评分者读取保留的标签并仅在完成后计算分数 提交的程序退出。 每个任务还通过双向验证门：维护者编写的 Oracle 必须产生声明的指标有效负载，而空提交则不能。 该门验证的是评分路径而不是任务表现。之前 官方评分，提交包将根据其工件进行检查 合同；然后在评分之前密封正式的比较包。失踪 伪影、畸形或非有限的预测， 超时和得分手失败会产生明显的失败或未得分状态 比数字零。Task versions, prompts, artifact contracts, preprocessing, data splits, scoring formulas, and content hashes are fixed before execution. Agent runs receive only their prepared workspaces and public task inputs. Scoring stages evaluator inputs outside the agent workspace. Submitted code executes in a no-network, non-root container with read-only code, model, and feature mounts; only its prediction directory is writable. The trusted task-owned grader reads held-out labels and computes the score only after the submitted program exits. Each task also passes a two-sided validation gate: a maintainer-authored Oracle must produce the declared metric payload, whereas an empty submission must not. This gate validates the scoring path rather than task performance. Before official scoring, the submission bundle is checked against its artifact contract; formal comparison bundles are then sealed before scoring. Missing artifacts, malformed or non-finite predictions, timeouts, and scorer failures produce explicit failed or unscored states rather than numerical zeroes.

5 案例研究Case study

我们还开展了多项 真实科研场景中的端到端案例研究，表明BrainPilot可以承载从无到有的多步骤分析到学术和科学成果。We also carry out several end-to-end case studies in real scientific research scenarios, showing that BrainPilot can carry a multi-step analysis from scratch to academic and scientific results.

5.1 压后皮质的空间编码Spatial coding in the retrosplenial cortex

BrainPilot 通过对压后皮质 (RSC) 的端到端空间编码分析进行评估，RSC 是一个涉及空间表征和导航的区域。这项任务非常适合代理，因为它需要跨数据集解释、神经行为对齐、统计筛选、交叉验证、可视化和科学报告的协调决策，而不是执行单个预定义的分析函数。双光子数据集 记录头部固定小鼠穿越 90 厘米虚拟现实时 RSC 的神经活动 直线轨道BrainPilot was evaluated on an end-to-end spatial-coding analysis in the retrosplenial cortex (RSC), a region implicated in spatial representation and navigation. This task is well suited to an agent because it requires coordinated decisions across dataset interpretation, neural–behavioral alignment, statistical screening, cross-validation, visualization, and scientific reporting, rather than the execution of a single predefined analysis function. The two-photon dataset records RSC neural activity while head-fixed mice traverse a 90 cm virtual-reality linear track(Mao et al., 2020)。研究人员提供了一个高层次的科学目标和五个所需的分析组成部分：. The researcher provided a high-level scientific objective and five requested analysis components:定位细胞筛选place-cell screening; 单细胞和群体可视化single-cell and population visualization; 贝叶斯位置解码Bayesian position decoding; 试验箱总体向量相关性trial-bin population-vector correlation;和; and发射率动态firing-rate dynamics，但没有具体说明完整的实施流程。 BrainPilot 将这些要求转化为数据集检查、会话选择、时间对齐、运行帧过滤、空间调整分析、保留解码、群体稳定性分析、可视化和报告生成的可执行序列。代理在这些组件之间维护共享的分析状态。这减少了手动交接，并防止了单独分析中不一致的参数选择。 BrainPilot 执行了分步协议（附录, but did not specify a complete implementation workflow. BrainPilot translated these requirements into an executable sequence of dataset inspection, session selection, temporal alignment, running-frame filtering, spatial-tuning analysis, held-out decoding, population-stability analysis, visualization, and report generation. The agent maintained a shared analysis state across these components. This reduced manual hand-offs and prevented inconsistent parameter choices across otherwise separate analyses. BrainPilot executed the step-by-step protocol (AppendixD）并产生结果 图中) and produced the results in Figure7.

BrainPilot 没有返回孤立的图，而是将输出组织成互补的证据级别。代表性热图显示了试验中重复出现的局部活动带 （图Rather than returning isolated plots, BrainPilot organized the outputs into complementary levels of evidence. Representative heatmaps show localized activity bands recurring across trials (Figure7a），与类似地点场的响应一致。的 交叉验证的人口地图仍然与坚持的大致对角线 当细胞按照从奇数试验估计的偏好排序时的试验 （图a), consistent with place-field-like responses. The cross-validated population map remains broadly diagonal on held-out even trials when cells are ordered by preferences estimated from odd trials (Figure7b).在坚持的试验中，贝叶斯解码器实现了 平均绝对误差为 16.8 厘米，真实解码位置相关性为b). On held-out trials, the Bayesian decoder achieved a mean absolute error of 16.8 cm and a true–decoded position correlation ofr=0.646r=0.646（图(Figure7c);重建的轨迹遵循 真实位置的整体进展具有明显的试验水平偏差 （图c); reconstructed trajectories followed the overall progression of true position with visible trial-level deviations (Figure7d).试验箱相关矩阵一般为 超出单位对角线为正，附近的 bin 之间具有更强的相似性 （图d). The trial-bin correlation matrix was generally positive beyond the unit diagonal, with stronger similarity among nearby bins (Figure7e).人口平均峰值率保持在 连续试验的有限范围（图e). Population mean peak rate remained within a limited range across consecutive trials (Figure7f），进一步 支持会话内稳定性。f), further supporting within-session stability.

五个输出共同提供从单细胞调谐到群体水平解码和会话内动态的补充检查。更重要的是，该案例评估了代理是否可以将高级神经科学请求转换为连贯且可重复的分析流程，解决数据集特定的实施细节，保持跨依赖阶段的方法论一致性，并将数值结果和图形合成为科学报告。Together, the five outputs provide complementary checks from single-cell tuning to population-level decoding and within-session dynamics. More importantly, the case evaluates whether an agent can convert a high-level neuroscience request into a coherent and reproducible analysis pipeline, resolve dataset-specific implementation details, preserve methodological consistency across dependent stages, and synthesize numerical results and figures into a scientific report.

5.3 功能连接功能磁共振成像疼痛解码Functional-connectivity fMRI pain decoding

持续的临床疼痛很难客观地描述，因为它 在很长的时间内展开，并与认知和情感交织在一起 流程。实验性强直性疼痛提供了一个可以捕获的受控模型 神经特征与持续的临床疼痛相同，使全脑发挥功能 连接性是可转移生物标志物的有前途的基础。强直性疼痛 因此，功能连接签名分析测试签名是否 从实验诱发的强直性疼痛中学到的知识可以推广到临床疼痛 严重程度和患者控制歧视，同时保留可解释性 网络和区域级结构Sustained clinical pain is difficult to characterize objectively because it unfolds over long timescales and is intertwined with cognitive and affective processes. Experimental tonic pain provides a controlled model that may capture neural features shared with ongoing clinical pain, making whole-brain functional connectivity a promising basis for transferable biomarkers. A tonic-pain functional-connectivity signature analysis therefore tests whether a signature learned from experimentally induced tonic pain can generalize to clinical pain severity and patient–control discrimination while retaining interpretable network- and region-level structure(Lee et al., 2021).

为了解决这个问题，BrainPilot 实施了实验性强直性疼痛 连接签名分析，在 CAPS 和 REST 上训练 FC 签名 数据并评估其转移到独立的临床疼痛数据集。每个 样本组成To address this question, BrainPilot implemented an experimental-tonic-pain connectivity-signature analysis that trained an FC signature on CAPS and REST data and evaluated its transfer to independent clinical pain datasets. Each sample comprised38,78138{,}781279 个感兴趣区域之间的成对连接。 实验性强直性疼痛队列首先用于模型训练和 坚持内部评价。然后将冷冻的签名应用于疼痛 四种亚急性和慢性背痛任务条件的严重程度预测， 随后在独立病例对照中进行慢性背痛分类 来自日本和英国的队列。学习到的权重最终被映射回 用于网络和区域级解释的 FC 空间 （图pairwise connections among 279 regions of interest. The experimental tonic-pain cohort was first used for model training and held-out internal evaluation. The frozen signature was then applied to pain severity prediction across four subacute- and chronic-back-pain task conditions, followed by chronic-back-pain classification in independent case–control cohorts from Japan and the UK. The learned weights were finally mapped back to FC space for network- and region-level interpretation (Figure9).

BrainPilot 使用分阶段代理工作流程。工程代理首先检查 数据，固定分析配置，培训和内部评估 实验性强直性疼痛特征，进行外部临床验证， 并重建了FC权重。然后，写作代理审查了结果 起草报告之前的脚本、模型、表格和图形，确保 每个结论都与保存的输出相关联。最后，审计代理 将报告与潜在的工件进行交叉检查，确定了较小的缺陷 不一致，并评估已完成分析的整体可靠性。BrainPilot used a staged agent workflow. An engineering agent first inspected the data, fixed the analysis configuration, trained and internally evaluated the experimental tonic-pain signature, performed the external clinical validations, and reconstructed the FC weights. A writing agent then reviewed the resulting scripts, models, tables, and figures before drafting the report, ensuring that each conclusion was tied to a saved output. Finally, an auditing agent cross-checked the report against the underlying artifacts, identified minor inconsistencies, and assessed the overall reliability of the completed analysis.

5.5 Sleep-EDF 睡眠分期，具有下游解码和生理验证Sleep-EDF sleep staging with downstream decoding and physiological validation

BrainPilot 在单通道 Fpz-Cz 上进行五级睡眠分期 Sleep-EDF 睡眠磁带中 20 个受试者的录音 子集BrainPilot performed five-class sleep staging on single-channel Fpz-Cz recordings from 20 subjects in the Sleep-EDF Sleep Cassette subset(Kemp et al., 2000; Goldberger et al., 2000)。每个 30 秒的纪元 被标记为唤醒、N1、N2、N3 或 REM。与多通道运动想象不同 案例中，该任务强调长窗形态、阶段特定频率 结构，以及通过可运行模型的催眠图连续性，完整 留一主体评价。. Each 30-second epoch was labeled Wake, N1, N2, N3, or REM. Unlike the multi-channel motor-imagery case, this task emphasized long-window morphology, stage-specific frequency structure, and hypnogram continuity through a runnable model, full leave-one-subject-out evaluation.

Sleep-EDF / DeepSleepNet 风格的协议The Sleep-EDF / DeepSleepNet-style protocol(Supratak et al., 2017)以 100 Hz 的频率对每个纪元进行采样，给出输入sampled each epoch at 100 Hz, giving inputs of(B,1,3000)(B,1,3000)，以及滤波后的信号 0.3 至 35 Hz 之间。排除运动和未知阶段，阶段 3 和 4 个被合并到 N3 中，并且 Wake epochs 围绕睡眠被裁剪。各 20 个 留一受试者折叠在 19 名受试者上进行训练并在其中一名受试者上进行测试，使用 100 预训练 epoch，然后是 200 个微调 epoch。, and filtered signals between 0.3 and 35 Hz. Movement and unknown stages were excluded, stages 3 and 4 were merged into N3, and Wake epochs were cropped around sleep. Each of 20 leave-one-subject-out folds trained on 19 subjects and tested on one, using 100 pretraining epochs followed by 200 fine-tuning epochs.

由此产生的The resulting睡眠代理模型SleepAgentModel映射的mapped(B,1,3000)(B,1,3000)输入到inputs to(B,5)(B,5)Logits 具有 237,813 个可训练参数。它结合了颞干， 跨越 delta 到 beta 形态的多尺度分支，一个融合块， 残差扩张时间卷积和五类分类器。 生理验证包括功率谱、带功率热图、 时间内核 FFT、梯度显着性、hypnograms 和转换矩阵 （图logits with 237,813 trainable parameters. It combined a temporal stem, multi-scale branches spanning delta through beta morphology, a fusion block, residual dilated temporal convolutions, and a five-class classifier. Physiological validation included power spectra, band-power heatmaps, temporal-kernel FFT, gradient saliency, hypnograms, and transition matrices (Figure11).

综合所有 20 名受试者的预测，Across held-out predictions from all 20 subjects,睡眠代理模型SleepAgentModel实现了 0.794 精度、0.725 宏 F1、0.724 平衡精度和 0.716 科恩的卡帕。所有四个指标都超过了多数类和类优先随机性 基线，但仍略低于 DeepSleepNet 参考文献achieved 0.794 accuracy, 0.725 macro-F1, 0.724 balanced accuracy, and 0.716 Cohen’s kappa. All four metrics exceeded majority-class and class-prior random baselines but remained slightly below the DeepSleepNet references(Supratak et al., 2017).

Wake、N2、N3 和 REM 的 F1 分数分别为 0.738、0.841、0.841 和 0.655， 分别。 N1是最难的课（Wake, N2, N3, and REM had F1 scores of 0.738, 0.841, 0.841, and 0.655, respectively. N1 was the most difficult class (F​1=0.339F1=0.339），有错误 集中在邻近或过渡阶段，与其相一致 模糊性以及各个阶段的难度分布不均匀。), with errors concentrated in neighboring or transitional stages, consistent with its ambiguity and with a nonuniform difficulty profile across stages.

功率谱显示 N3 中的 delta 功率最高，N2 中的 sigma 增强， 与慢波和纺锤体相关的生理学一致。时间内核 频谱涵盖 delta、theta/alpha、sigma 和更高频率的分量。 梯度显着性识别了本地相关的波形段，但提供了 只有微弱的归因证据；保留催眠图和转换矩阵 广泛的舞台连续性，同时显示局部错误。Power spectra showed the highest delta power in N3 and sigma enhancement in N2, consistent with slow-wave and spindle-related physiology. Temporal-kernel spectra covered delta, theta/alpha, sigma, and higher-frequency components. Gradient saliency identified locally relevant waveform segments but provided only weak attribution evidence; hypnograms and transition matrices preserved broad stage continuity while showing local errors.

唤醒 alpha 功率并不明显占主导地位，并且单个 Fpz-Cz 通道 排除空间或地形解释。更强有力的主张需要 在同一代码库、其他数据集和其他数据集中复制了 DeepSleepNet 基线 对纺锤体、K 复合物和慢波进行更严格的事件级分析。Wake alpha power was not clearly dominant, and the single Fpz-Cz channel precludes spatial or topographic interpretation. Stronger claims require a reproduced DeepSleepNet baseline in the same codebase, additional datasets, and more rigorous event-level analyses of spindles, K-complexes, and slow waves.

6 讨论Discussion

基准测试和评估。Benchmarking and evaluation.

评估大脑代理系统 科学仍然是一个开放的、要求高的和资源成本的问题。该领域提供的基准很少 衡量完整的研究工作流程，其中大多数侧重于孤立的 知识或任务的准确性。构建一项现实任务需要 大量专家时间来获取数据，指定 所需的工件和评分合同，冻结参考或保留 数据，并验证特定于任务的评分器。其中比较多的是 特工期末考试的一千多项任务中，只有三项属于神经科学。 因此，全领域的评估需要社区的努力。我们对待 BrainPilotBench-v0 作为第一个框架，其评分工具已经存在 地方。添加任务需要其数据、提示、工件合同和评分者， 以及更广泛的 覆盖范围将使基准测试扩展到更多子域。Evaluating an agentic system for brain science remains an open, demanding and resource-cost problem. The field offers few benchmarks that measure a complete research workflow, with most focusing on isolated knowledge or task accuracy. Building one realistic task requires substantial expert time to source data, specify the required artifacts and scoring contract, freeze the reference or held-out data, and validate a task-specific grader. Among the more than one thousand tasks in Agents’ Last Exam, only three fall in neuroscience. A field-wide evaluation therefore calls for a community effort. We treat BrainPilotBench-v0 as a first framework whose scoring harness is already in place. Adding a task requires its data, prompt, artifact contract, and grader, and broader coverage will extend the benchmark across more subdomains.我们公开发布方法论和首要任务，并邀请 社区提出任务、贡献数据、定义基本事实并完善 得分。We release the methodology and first tasks openly and invite the community to propose tasks, contribute data, define ground truth, and refine scoring.

领域知识和实验室经验。Domain knowledge and laboratory experience.

一个领域的工作知识涵盖教科书、研究论文、分析工具、实践经验和实验室特定惯例。 (1)A field’s working knowledge spans textbooks, research papers, analytical tools, hands-on experience, and laboratory-specific conventions. (1)知识库：Knowledge base:BrainPilot 将已发表的知识组织到一个检索语料库中，该语料库可以随着通过相同的摄取和索引管道处理新文献而增长。 (2)BrainPilot organizes published knowledge into a retrieval corpus that can grow as new literature is processed through the same ingestion and indexing pipeline. (2)技能库：Skill library:技能记录可重用方法及其适用范围和参数选择。这些区别至关重要，因为相同的实验范式在不同的采集条件、数据属性和研究目标下可能需要不同的分析和参数。元技能进一步将论文、软件、完整的工作流程和专家知识转换为可审查的技能单元，使图书馆能够通过社区贡献不断发展，并提供适用于其他知识密集型科学领域的构建模式。Skills record reusable methods together with their applicability boundaries and parameter choices. These distinctions are essential because the same experimental paradigm may require different analyses and parameters under different acquisition conditions, data properties, and research objectives. Meta-skills further convert papers, software, completed workflows, and expert knowledge into reviewable skill units, allowing the library to evolve through community contributions and providing a construction pattern applicable to other knowledge-intensive scientific domains.我们还呼吁社区从实验室经验中贡献出更具体、更精确的技能。We also call for the community to contribute more concrete and precise skills from lab experiences.

人机交互和科学有效性。Human-in-the-loop and scientific validity.

BrainPilot 通过澄清问题、与 PI 代理的执行前讨论以及用于检查中间操作和输出的界面来支持专家参与。除了我们的案例研究中强调的端到端任务完成之外，研究人员还可以完善问题的表述，提供特定于研究的先验知识，并在执行之前审查方法选择，从而帮助防止不适当的决策在工作流程中传播。BrainPilot supports expert participation through clarification questions, pre-execution discussion with the PI agent, and interfaces for inspecting intermediate actions and outputs. Beyond the end-to-end task completion emphasized in our case studies, researchers can refine the problem formulation, supply study-specific prior knowledge, and review methodological choices before execution, helping prevent unsuitable decisions from propagating through the workflow.与此同时，研究人员有责任在使用 BrainPilot 的分析、解释和结论来支持科学主张之前对其进行验证。Meanwhile, researchers retain responsibility for validating BrainPilot’s analyses, interpretations, and conclusions before using them to support scientific claims.审计员通过检查会议中的证据是否支持主张来纳入额外的验证步骤，而对方法论的合理性、统计有效性和科学解释的更广泛的检查仍然是以专家为中心的验证的重要方向。The Auditor incorporates an additional verification step by checking whether claims are supported by evidence in the session, while broader checks of methodological soundness, statistical validity, and scientific interpretation remain important directions for expert-centered verification.

研究子任务的组合工作流程。Compositional workflows for research subtasks.

目前，一个 要求很高的子任务，例如深入的文献调查或起草 学术论文的撰写由一名专业代理人完成，并且 由 PI 审核。社区已经开发了成熟的工作流程 这些活动。允许专业代理实例化子工作流和 按需子代理将支持更精细、适合任务且 多阶段程序，同时保留相同的人在环和 可审计的结构。撰写既定的深入研究和学术写作 现有 PI-专家-人类架构的管道将加深 每个专业代理的能力。At present, a demanding subtask such as an in-depth literature investigation or the drafting of a academic paper is carried out by a single specialist agent and reviewed by the PI. The community has developed mature workflows for exactly these activities. Allowing a specialist agent to instantiate subworkflows and subagents on demand would support more elaborate, task-appropriate, and multi-stage procedures while preserving the same human-in-the-loop and auditable structure. Composing established deep-research and academic-writing pipelines into the existing PI–specialist–human architecture would deepen the capabilities of each specialist agent.

多模式和跨模式数据集成。Multimodal and cross-modal data integration.

脑科学取得进展 通过整合跨尺度和模式的证据——电生理学， 双光子和功能成像、脑电图、行为和分子数据以及许多 最重要的问题中的一些恰恰存在于它们之间的边界处。 我们当前的案例研究均以单一模式进行；延伸 BrainPilot 联合加载、对齐和推理异构模式，以及 为了得出跨模式的结论，系统可以解决以下问题： 需要来自多种数据类型的证据。Brain science advances by integrating evidence across scales and modalities—electrophysiology, two-photon and functional imaging, EEG, behavior, and molecular data—and many of the most important questions live precisely at the boundaries between them. Our current case studies each operate within a single modality; extending BrainPilot to jointly load, align, and reason over heterogeneous modalities, and to draw cross-modal conclusions, would let the system address questions that require evidence from multiple data types.

7 结论Conclusion

我们推出了 BrainPilot，这是一种人机循环多智能体系统，可加速 脑科学研究，同时保持过程可供专家验证。一位校长 调查员 (PI) 代理协调专家代理进行文献基础， 实验设计、执行、写作和独立审核。他们的工作是 以精选领域知识为基础：统一的脑科学知识库 包含 7,233 个索引项目和包含 72 种可重用方法的技能库 跨七个研究领域的单位。的图表 Trace 提供了一个仅附加的、可审计的记录，链接了子目标、工具使用、 证据和主张，而专门的审计员则将捏造事实纳入其中 检查方法。这种架构允许研究人员遵循， 检查并指导研究的整个执行过程。We presented BrainPilot, a human-in-the-loop multi-agent system that accelerates brain science research while keeping the process ready for experts’ verification. A principal investigator (PI) agent coordinates specialist agents for literature grounding, experimental design, execution, writing, and independent audit. Their work is grounded in curated domain knowledge: a unified brain science knowledge base containing 7,233 indexed items and a skill library of 72 reusable methodology units across seven research domains. The Graph of Trace provides an append-only, auditable record linking subgoals, tool use, evidence, and claims, while a dedicated Auditor agent incorporates fabrication checking into the method. This architecture allows researchers to follow, inspect, and steer a study throughout its execution.

我们在特工最后一次考试中评估了 BrainPilot，BrainPilotBench-v0 具有四个大脑 科学任务和端到端案例 研究涵盖系统神经科学、小鼠视觉生理学、 功能连接功能磁共振成像和脑电图解码。在这些评价中， 具有开源骨干模型的 BrainPilot 取得了可比的性能 最先进的代理框架 较低的货币成本。最后，我们再次呼吁社区为通过代理研究加速和自动化大脑发现的广阔未来做出贡献。We evaluated BrainPilot on Agents’ Last Exam, BrainPilotBench-v0 with four brain science tasks, and end-to-end case studies spanning systems neuroscience, mouse visual physiology, functional-connectivity fMRI, and EEG decoding. Across these evaluations, BrainPilot with an open-source backbone model achieved performance comparable to state-of-the-art agent framework at a lower monetary cost. We finally call again for the contribution of the community to a broad future of accelarating and automating brain discovery with agentic research.

BrainPilot 作为用于进行脑科学的本地网络应用程序发布 使用第 1 节中描述的多智能体系统进行研究BrainPilot is released as a local web application for conducting brain science research with the multi-agent system described in Section3。 推荐的单用户设置直接通过 npm 运行，无需 Docker。 使用 Node.js 22 或更高版本，可以使用两个安装和启动 BrainPilot 命令：. The recommended single-user setup runs directly through npm without Docker. With Node.js 22 or newer, BrainPilot can be installed and launched with two commands:

⬇
新项目管理npm 安装install -g @brainpilot/应用程序app
大脑飞行员brainpilot up

启动后，用户打开终端中打印的本地地址并 配置模型提供者。浏览器界面汇集了研究成果 对话、座席活动、会话历史记录以及期间生成的文件 工作流程（图After launch, the user opens the local address printed in the terminal and configures a model provider. The browser interface brings together the research conversation, agent activity, session history, and files produced during the workflow (Figure12).

BrainPilotBench 是用于运行、验证、 以及评分代理提交的脑科学任务。它是从一个安装的 源代码检查并包含一个捆绑示例，可以练习完整的 本地验证、评分和排行榜工作流程，无需模型 API 密钥、BrainPilot 部署或 Docker。当前任务设置、数据准备、 代理适配器和评分说明均保留在其自述文件中。BrainPilotBench is the companion evaluation framework for running, verifying, and scoring agent submissions on brain science tasks. It is installed from a source checkout and includes a bundled example that exercises the complete verification, scoring, and leaderboard workflow locally without a model API key, a BrainPilot deployment, or Docker. Current task setup, data preparation, agent adapters, and scoring instructions are maintained in its README.

单身single-频道channel 睡眠Sleep-法国电力公司EDF 脑电图EEG. 的The 模型model 应该should 并入incorporate 睡觉sleep-脑电图EEG
解码decoding 先验priors 没有without 成为becoming 过度地overly 复杂的complex.
推荐Recommended 组件components 关注follow.
1. 颞叶Temporal 卷积convolution
包括Include 转换1dConv1d or 转换2dConv2d to 过程process 的the 30-第二second 脑电图EEG 波形waveform. 转换1dConv1d
is 首选preferred 因为because 的the 输入input is a 单身single-频道channel 时间time 系列series:
(批次Batch, 1, 3000)
2. 多Multi-规模scale 时间性的temporal 内核kernels
睡眠Sleep 阶段stages 依赖depend on 不同的different 频率frequency 乐队bands 和and 形态学morphologies:
- 达美Delta / 慢slow 波wave: 0.5--4 Hz, 主要是mainly 关联的associated 与with N3
- 西塔Theta: 4--8 Hz, 常见的common in N1 / 快速眼动睡眠REM
- 阿尔法Alpha: 8--13 Hz, 关联的associated 与with 唤醒Wake
- 西格玛Sigma / 主轴spindle: 11--16 Hz, 关联的associated 与with N2
- 贝塔Beta: 13--30 Hz, 关联的associated 与with 唤醒Wake / 唤醒arousal
的The 模型model 可能may 使用use 转换1dConv1d 分支机构branches 与with 不同的different 内核kernel 尺寸sizes, 为了for
例子example a 更长longer 内核kernel 为了for 慢slow 波浪waves 和and a 更短shorter 内核kernel 为了for
锭子spindles or 瞬态transient 事件events.
3. 本地Local 时间性的temporal 上下文context
虽然Although 的the 输入input 包含contains 仅only 一one 30-第二second 纪元epoch, 的the 模型model 应该should
捕获capture 本地的local 时间性的temporal 结构structure 之内within 的the 纪元epoch. 可能Possible 组件components
包括include:
- 扩张的dilated 转换1dConv1d
- TCN-风格style 残差residual 块blocks

If a 经常性的recurrent 模块module is 使用过的used, 保留keep 它的its 参数parameter 计数count 小small to 减少reduce
过拟合overfitting.
4. 小号Small-样品sample 概括generalization
的The 评价evaluation 数据集dataset is 小small, so 避免avoid an 超大的oversized 模型model.

Do 不not 使用use a 非常very 大large 变压器Transformer or 美国有线电视新闻网CNN.

唤醒Wake 和and N2 可能may be 更多more 经常frequent in 睡眠Sleep-法国电力公司EDF, 和and N1 is 通常usually 的the
大多数most 困难difficult 类class. 的The 模型model 应该should 避免avoid 完成complete 依赖dependence on 的the

# 推荐Recommended 建筑学architecture
使用Use 的the 正在关注following as 设计design 方向directions, 不not as 伪代码pseudocode to 复制copy.
- 颞叶Temporal 茎stem:
- 转换1dConv1d(1, C, 内核大小kernel_size=大large, 跨步stride=小small, 填充padding=...）=...)
- BatchNorm1d

- 多Multi-规模scale 分支机构branches:
- 分行branch 1: 长long 内核kernel 为了for 慢slow 波浪waves
- 分行branch 2: 中等medium 内核kernel 为了for 西塔theta/阿尔法alpha
- 分行branch 3: 短short 内核kernel 为了for 西格玛sigma/主轴spindle-喜欢like 事件events
- 融合Fusion:
- 连接concatenate 分支机构branches
- 1x1 转换1dConv1d 融合fusion
- BatchNorm1d
- 辍学Dropout
- 颞叶Temporal 上下文context:

- 展平Flatten
- 辍学Dropout
- 线性Linear(..., 5)
